callees.name: _wait_opencode_process
callees.pre_condition: proc is a running subprocess.Popen instance; command is a non-empty list of strings; stage is a non-empty string; timeout_seconds is a positive integer.
callees.post_condition: Waits for proc to complete up to timeout_seconds. Returns a 2-tuple (exit_code, error). On normal completion within the timeout, exit_code is the process's exit code and error is None. On timeout, proc is terminated (SIGTERM), then force-killed (SIGKILL) if termination does not complete within a 10-second grace period; exit_code is the process's exit code after termination (or -15 if the exit code would be 0), and error is a descriptive timeout message string.
